lines.text: David and thirty thousand chosen men of Israel set out for Baale of Judah to bring up the ark of God.
They set the ark on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzzah and Ahio guided it.
At the threshing floor of Gilgal, Uzzah took hold of the ark because the oxen stumbled, and God struck him down.
David took the ark aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite, where it stayed three months and the LORD blessed his household.
When those carrying the ark had gone six paces, David sacrificed a ram and a fattened calf and danced before the LORD.
